_comment: Rakshak evaluation set v2. v1 (15 examples) was the same set tests/unit/test_char_detection.py already characterizes -- see docs/ml/phase8-evaluation.md for why a 1.0/1.0/1.0 score on that set was not evidence of generalization. v2 adds the credential/MFA social-engineering cases from a detection audit (tests/unit/test_scam_regression.py's MALICIOUS_CASES/BENIGN_CASES) that v1 had zero coverage of at all -- the exact gap that produced a false negative on a plain 'reply with the verification code' message. Expand this file, don't edit test_char_detection.py's copy to match -- they serve different purposes (this is evaluation data; that is behavior-pinning).
